name: code-treemap
description: Deterministic static SVG treemap generator for LerayHopf/ Lean source code LOC. Isolated from the Lake package.

scripts.measure: mkdir -p build && cd ../.. && tools/code-treemap/node_modules/.bin/cloc --by-file --json --quiet LerayHopf.lean LerayHopf > tools/code-treemap/build/code-loc.json
scripts.build: npm run measure && npm run generate
